postings.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
postings.description:
View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/us-csm https://juro.notion.site/us-csm?source=copy_link



***




THE KEY BITS



 - Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located in Massachusetts and have long-term working rights in the US.

 - Flexibility: We have office hubs in Boston (US) and London (UK) as well as no-office hubs in several European countries. We operate a choice-first work https://app.notion.com/juro/p/Choice-first-work-4044718b99fa4e2baa84a88a1051eab9?pvs=24 approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near an office hub. For this role, we prioritise candidates who prefer to work from our Boston office at least ~2 days a week.

 - Salary: We benchmarked $145,000 + 20% annual bonus (in 4x quarterly instalments based on performance targets) + equity at IC4 level in our progression framework https://app.notion.com/juro/p/Progression-framework-c9acbf27ec464b81b5bd4b3a22abe6dc?pvs=24 for someone based in Massachusetts.

 - Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 2.5 hours over 2 weeks, incl. a home task.

 - Start date: As soon as you can start.

 - Reporting to: George Hughes, Head of Customer Success

 - More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers http://juro.com/careers, our handbook https://juro.notion.site/handbook or ask talent@juro.com anything.






HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER




Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated https://www.law.com/legaltechnews/2023/03/30/legal-industry-reacts-to-goldman-sachs-generative-ai-report-keep-calm-and-panic/?slreturn=20231019075707 with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.



2026 is a big growth year for Juro. Our customer base is growing fast, especially in the US, and more teams are relying on us daily.

A lot of our customers have got early value from Juro and are ready for what comes next. They want more guidance, better alignment across their teams, and help embedding Juro into how they really work.

To deliver that at scale, we need smart automation paired with strategic human connection. As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you'll build the playbooks, automations, and touchpoints that help customers succeed while identifying the moments where your personal involvement drives the most impact.

You'll own a ~$3M book of business and have a voice in shaping how CS evolves as Juro grows.



Every Customer Success Manager’s mission at Juro is to make Juro's customers successful. Great means:

 1. Portfolio health is strong

 2. Customers are retained, growing and expanding

 3. Champions are identified and nurtured across key accounts

 4. Customer feedback is shared clearly to product and GTM teams

 5. You manage large / complex customers, coach junior CSMs + lead team initiatives



We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits https://juro.notion.site/benefits and choice-first work https://juro.notion.site/choice-first-work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub https://juro.notion.site/dei.






WHO WE LOOK FOR



Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.



Every Juror finds their balance across our four principles https://www.notion.so/Principles-acf77a5d174f427eb46aa3134a206296?pvs=21 — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day. Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz https://my-juro-personality.lovable.app/ to see how you map against our principles.



On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

 - You’ve built 3+ years* of customer-facing experience at an AI or SaaS scale-up (Series A-D).

 - You’ve engaged senior stakeholders, including Director level and above, holding credible, value-led conversations.

 - You’re confident consistently identifying and nurturing customer relationships across multiple accounts.

 - You’re known for strong discovery and problem solving skills, digging into what’s not working and taking action to move things forward proactively.



* What you did is more important than how long you did it. While this range is an orientation for you to understand the level of experience we’re looking for, we still want to hear from you if you think you have what it takes but don't quite meet this number.



This job likely isn’t for you if:

 - Rolling up your sleeves in an early‑stage, “build‑the‑playbook‑as‑we‑go” environment feels chaotic instead of energising.

 - You're not comfortable with travel to meet customers in person. This role involves building relationships face-to-face, not just over Zoom.

 - Working outside a rigid 9‑to‑5 window (to catch East & West Coast customers) sounds like more hassle than opportunity.






OUR MISSION




Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making legal contracts frictionless, collaborative and accessible.

Juro’s intelligent contract automation platform is on its way to de-throning desktop tools as the paradigm for collaborating on legal documentation around the world.

We’re doing that by rebuilding contracts from the ground-up around a browser-native experience, augmenting workflows with powerful AI and enabling all teams to conduct contracting jobs faster than ever before.






GOT MORE QUESTIONS?



Check if they're answered on:

 - Our extended job description for this role: https://juro.notion.site/us-csm https://juro.notion.site/us-csm?source=copy_link

 - Our company handbook: https://juro.notion.site/handbook https://juro.notion.site/handbook?pvs=4

 - Our careers page: https://juro.notion.site https://juro.notion.site/



There, you'll find answers on topics such as career progression, inclusion & belonging, the interview process, benefits and more. Or reach talent@juro.com for anything.

postings.title: Finance Operations Associate
postings.description:
View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/fao



***




THE KEY BITS



 - Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

 - Flexibility: We have office hubs in London and Boston, as well as no-office hubs in several European countries. We operate a choice-first work approach https://juro.notion.site/choice-first-work that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near an office hub.

 - Salary: We benchmarked £45,000 + equity at IC2 in our progression framework https://juro.notion.site/progression for someone based in the UK. Let us know in your application if you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for.

 - Interviews: 2 stages totalling around 2.5 hours over 2 weeks, plus some prep for a task.

 - Start date: As soon as you can start.

 - Reporting to: Charlotte, Financial Controller

 - More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers http://juro.com/careers, our handbook https://juro.notion.site/handbook or ask talent@juro.com.






HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER




Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated https://www.law.com/legaltechnews/2023/03/30/legal-industry-reacts-to-goldman-sachs-generative-ai-report-keep-calm-and-panic/?slreturn=20231019075707 with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.



Juro bills customers and pays suppliers across UK and US entities, and the volume keeps growing. We’re looking for someone who carries the day-to-day weight of finance operations together with the team.

Roughly 60% of your week goes on AP/AR, and the rest is month-end and reporting support: reconciliations, revenue review, and pulling together what’s needed for statutory accounts, audit requests and VAT returns.

You won’t be doing this alone: you’ll work closely with Charlotte, our Financial Controller, who owns the close, and Ryan, our Interim Finance Director (stepping in for Eimear), who leads the Finance function.



Your mission is to:

Own invoicing, payables and collections end-to-end so Juro gets paid efficiently, accurately and with strong control of cash, and support month-end so leadership can trust the numbers.



Success looks like:

 1. Invoices done right first time: Contracts are turned into accurate invoices with minimal rework or back-and-forth with Sales and Customer Success.

 2. Money moving smoothly: Customers pay on time and suppliers are paid accurately across our UK and US entities. You keep an up-to-date view of what’s owed in and out, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) comes down over time.

 3. Reliable month-end support: Your reconciliations are accurate and on time, you flag escalations early, and you contribute to month-end, revenue review and statutory reporting.

 4. Solid, scalable ops: Processes are well controlled (from supplier onboarding and bank detail checks to payment run approvals), audit-ready, and increasingly automated inside Rillet (our ERP) and Ramp (our spend management system). You improve the process notes rather than just following them.



We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits https://juro.notion.site/benefits and choice-first work https://juro.notion.site/choice-first-work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub https://juro.notion.site/dei.






WHO WE LOOK FOR



Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.



To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four principles https://app.notion.com/p/Principles-acf77a5d174f427eb46aa3134a206296?pvs=21. We hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz https://my-juro-personality.lovable.app/ to see how you map against our principles.



On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

 - You’ve done both AR and AP: raising invoices, handling billing queries, chasing payments or paying suppliers.

 - You’ve been the #1 point of contact for customers or suppliers on billing and payments. You can be firm about an overdue balance without damaging the relationship, and you keep Sales, CS and budget holders in the loop.

 - You’ve helped with a month-end, e.g. by doing bank or ledger reconciliations.

 - You’ve used finance systems day to day (NetSuite, Rillet, Xero, Ramp or similar) and pick up new tools quickly.

 - You read contracts carefully enough to know what should be invoiced, when, and what’s unclear, and you work with Sales and CS to get it right.

 - You notice repetitive manual work and want to fix it, whether that’s with a better spreadsheet, an automation or AI.



Bonus points if:

 - You’ve worked with SaaS contracts or subscription billing.

 - You’ve helped with VAT returns, US sales tax, revenue reporting or audit requests.

 - You’ve worked in a multi-entity (UK/US) business with multi-currency invoicing.



This job likely isn’t for you if:

 - You’re mainly looking for formal accounting training or a pathway to becoming ACA-qualified.

 - You want to own the month-end close or focus on technical accounting, rather than a hands-on mix of finance operations and reporting support.

 - You prefer clearly defined, static processes and don’t enjoy owning messy, real-world problems and making them better (especially with AI).






OUR MISSION




Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

The load on legal teams is increasing as business teams move faster with the help of AI. The only way out is to deploy AI within the legal team so that (a) routine contract work can be executed autonomously and (b) lawyers’ time is reserved for problem solving.

It’s like having an extra team member that is always on and takes on heavy lifting. Just like an in-house lawyer, Juro:

 - is present for, and trusted by, business teams

 - owns contracts from first draft to signature and beyond

 - builds judgement from every contract it works on

…all within guardrails controlled by the legal team.






GOT MORE QUESTIONS?

 - Our company handbook: https://juro.notion.site/handbook https://juro.notion.site/handbook?pvs=4

 - Our careers page: https://juro.notion.site https://juro.notion.site/



There, you'll find answers on topics such as career progression, inclusion & belonging, the interview process, benefits and more. Or reach talent@juro.com for anything.

postings.description:
View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/aie



***




THE KEY BITS



 - Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

 - Flexibility: We have office hubs in London and Boston, as well as no-office hubs in several European countries. We operate a choice-first work approach https://juro.notion.site/choice-first-work that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near an office hub.

 - Salary: We benchmarked £115,000 + equity at IC4 level in our progression framework https://juro.notion.site/progression for someone based in the UK. What you’ve done in the last ~2 years is far more important to us than how long you’ve been an engineer — so if you think you meet the requirements but are worried you’re not “senior” enough, we strongly encourage you to still apply. If you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for, let us know in your application.

 - Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 3 hours over 2-3 weeks.

 - Start date: As soon as you can start.

 - Reporting to: Pavel Nekrasov https://www.linkedin.com/in/pavel-e-nekrasov/, Director of Engineering and lead of the Agentic team at Juro

 - More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers http://juro.com/careers, our handbook https://juro.notion.site/handbook or ask talent@juro.com anything.






HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER




Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it.

With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.



Our Agentic team was the first team at Juro to go fully AI-native, and it's been the role model for our other product teams as Juro evolved into an AI company.

As the Agentic team, we build the AI foundations the rest of engineering ships on — starting with Operator https://juro.com/operator, the agent that works across contracts inside Juro.

We want Operator to do a lot more. That takes more and better tools, solid evals, and a harness that keeps up with a stack that’s still rapidly evolving. And more great people to do it.



What you're here to do

Give Operator the tools it needs to act across Juro and make sure what it does is measurably good. In your first months, success looks like this:

 - You've shipped new tools that connect Operator to the Juro app, from first idea to production.

 - What you ship has evals around it, supported by the Quality Assurance team, so we can tell whether a new model, prompt or library version makes things better or worse.

 - You own parts of the agent harness (planning, tool use, context) without the team becoming a. bottleneck.

 - You review a lot of agent-written code and decide quickly what's safe to merge and what will break three cycles later.



We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits https://juro.notion.site/benefits and choice-first work https://juro.notion.site/choice-first-work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub https://juro.notion.site/dei.

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.



To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four core Principles https://app.notion.com/p/Principles-acf77a5d174f427eb46aa3134a206296?pvs=21 — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz https://my-juro-personality.lovable.app/ to see how you map against our principles.



On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

 - You’re a programmer first, and you now build with AI and LLMs. You’ve written production TypeScript/Node.js and MongoDB for users. Agents write most of the code today, but you can still tell when an agent’s output shouldn’t go through.

 - You’ve built agentic systems yourself, including the tools that let agents act on APIs and integrations. You can explain the parts of an agent (planning, tools, context, the loop around them) because you’ve built them.

 - You’ve written and run evals and think about quality in probabilities.

 - You’ve shipped something people can use: a product, an open-source project or a tool. (We’ll ask you for a link or description in our application form.)

 - Bonus: you’ve used our AI stack before. It changes often, so understanding why things break matters more than knowing the tools already.



Day to day, you’ll work with Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Redis and pgvector on AWS, plus Bedrock, LiteLLM and Mastra for the AI layer.

These requirements can come from a job, a side project or open source. The field is about two years old, so we care about what you've built, not how many years you've been doing it.



This job likely isn’t for you if:

 - You need a polished setup before you can ship. We'd rather ship a small, good version this week than a perfect one in two weeks, by which time the stack has moved on.

 - You want a stable roadmap. Priorities here can change week to week.

 - You want to rebuild things whenever you'd have done them differently. We disagree a lot and openly, but once a call is made, we commit and move.

 - You've only ever worked inside one opinionated framework and never looked under the hood.

 - You'd rather build product UI. Most of this work is foundations other engineers build on.
